segments.text: Welcome to this lesson on trading psychology.
segments.tr: 欢迎来到交易心理学这一课。

segments.text: Today we talk about fear and greed in the market.
segments.tr: 今天我们聊聊市场中的恐惧与贪婪。

segments.text: Most traders lose money because they cannot control risk.
segments.tr: 大多数交易者亏钱，是因为无法控制风险。

segments.text: Before every trade, decide how much you are willing to lose.
segments.tr: 每次交易前，先决定你愿意亏多少。

segments.text: If the market breaks the level, you follow it.
segments.tr: 如果市场突破了这个位置，你就跟上。

segments.text: Never add to a losing position.
Let your profits run, and cut your losses short.
This is the core of the edge cycle system.
